Parent issue: #170

Stage: simplified-self-merge

## Task

Implement a clean simplified self-merge PR stacked on parent PR #186. Use base_pr #186. Reference the desired behavior from PR #208 and the discussion at https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/208#issuecomment-4422872638, but recreate the changes cleanly from #186's head branch rather than using PR #208's mis-stacked branch. Desired behavior: after agent self-approval has approved the current head, self-merge should merge the PR into its configured base when checks/mergeability pass and there are no requested changes. Keep the core safeguards only: AGENT_ALLOW_SELF_MERGE remains opt-in and false by default; require current-head Sepo self-approval; require no blocking requested changes; preserve check/mergeability handling; bind final merge/auto-merge commands with --match-head-commit. Simplify away the over-conservative guardrails from #202: draft PRs should be eligible by marking them ready before merge/auto-merge, and stacked/non-default same-repo bases should not be blocked merely because they are not the default branch. Update focused tests and docs. Do not close or retarget PR #208 from the implementation unless explicitly necessary; it is reference context and likely a duplicate/mis-stacked PR.

## Base

- base_pr: #186
